title: LearnPrunerV2: Learnable Progressive Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal capabilities but suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to the massive number of visual tokens. While token pruning is a promising solution, existing methods still suffer from two major drawbacks: 1) unreliable pruning criteria that fail to accurately localize task-specific regions due to inherent attention biases or query-agnostic designs, and 2) suboptimal pruning strategies that employ rigid, non-adaptive schedules, overlooking the dynamic evolution of token redundancy across different model depths. To address these challenges, we propose LearnPrunerV2, which extends the previous two-stage heuristic framework (LearnPruner) into a fully learnable architecture. translated_title: LearnPrunerV2：面向视觉-语言模型的可学习渐进式词元剪枝
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型展现了卓越的多模态能力，但由于海量的视觉词元而面临高昂的计算开销。尽管词元剪枝是一种有前景的解决方案，现有方法仍存在两大主要缺陷：1）剪枝准则不可靠——由于固有的注意力偏差或查询无关的设计，无法准确定位任务相关区域；2）剪枝策略次优——采用僵化、非自适应的调度方式，忽视了词元冗余度在不同模型深度中的动态演变。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 LearnPrunerV2，它将之前的两阶段启发式框架（LearnPruner）扩展为完全可学习的架构。具体而言，我们在视觉-语言模型主干的每一层中集成了轻量级可学习模块，通过融合内在视觉显著性与外在查询相关性来估计词元重要性……
tldr: 该论文提出 LearnPrunerV2，通过在视觉-语言模型每一层嵌入轻量级可学习模块，融合视觉显著性与查询相关性来自适应地估计词元重要性，实现完全可学习的渐进式词元剪枝，从而在大幅降低计算开销的同时保持多模态性能。
en_tdlr: LearnPrunerV2 extends prior heuristic token pruning into a fully learnable progressive framework, embedding lightweight modules in every VLM layer that fuse intrinsic visual saliency with query relevance to adaptively prune tokens across depths, reducing computational overhead while preserving multimodal performance.
